bby-41.script: Nobody hands you a good day. You build it. How you talk. How you treat people. How you show up. That's all you.

bby-43.script: You think you need strength to let it go. You don't. You need to understand it. Understand why, and your hands open.

bby-44.script: Maybe the first time wasn't your fault. Maybe the timing just wasn't ready. That's what second chances are for. Take yours today.

bby-45.script: Be angry. You've earned it. But don't be cruel. Anger fades by tomorrow. Cruel words stay for years. Feel it. Just don't throw it.

bby-47.script: You've been watching other people live their dream. Cheering them on. That's good. But your life isn't on pause. Today you start yours.

bby-48.script: If it brings you more tears than laughter, stop carrying it. Not next year. Not someday. Today. Put it down and walk lighter.
